status.plainEnglish: Every measured creator is below 10 percentage-point MAE in both the protected frozen tail and the prequential next-upload replay, and the selected content mixture beats the matched recent-30 history baseline descriptively in each account. The improvement is small for some accounts and the historical tail has been inspected, so prospective confirmation is still required.
status.promotionBlocker: Prospective uploads have not yet confirmed the locked artifact, and current labels are cumulative snapshots rather than one fixed post-upload horizon.
status.confidenceWarning: Per-account mean MAE below 10, individual predictions within ±10, bootstrap confidence, and incremental value over history are different claims. The UI shows each separately.
status.batchBacklog: supported only as the separately reported frozen stress; operational updates require observed intervening outcomes
leakageBlockers: one or more internal accounts/channels could not be resolved to a canonical YouTube channel ID
whole-creator exclusion was not proven for every evaluation group
one or more upstream fit rows lack strong source/content lineage, so different-ID reupload overlap cannot be ruled out
one or more evaluation rows have only weak, identity-only, or absent duplicate-family evidence

input: The canonical 1,536D visual opening embedding, the canonical 1,536D together visual-plus-text opening embedding, and up to 30 strictly earlier measured keep outcomes from the explicit creator profile.
valueDefinition: A raw predicted stayed-to-watch percentage for a known creator's next upload. It is a multimodal derived forecast, not a new embedding space and not a visual-only score.

selection.protocol: A staged registry of 43,360 prespecified time-ordered candidates is evaluated only on each creator's chronological 50%-80% window. The final 20% is never read by candidate selection. Equal publication timestamps are one simultaneous batch.

selected.formula: 0.5 * stage2 centered-together pooled residual analog + 0.5 * stage3 visual+together semantic stack

evaluation.protocol: Prequential replay on the final 20% of every creator. Each equal-time batch is predicted before any outcome in that batch is revealed; revealed outcomes may inform only strictly later uploads. This evaluates temporal prediction, not a causal effect.
evaluation.claimBoundary: Retrospective known-creator next-upload evidence with at least eight earlier labels. The development tail has now been inspected, so this is not a virgin prospective confirmation. Cold start and anonymous upload scoring are unsupported.

ablations.interpretation: History-only, visual-only, together-only, and the selection-locked multimodal formula are shown separately. The final-tail visual-only result is an ablation, not a post-hoc replacement for the formula selected before the final tail.

rollingBlockStability.matchedBaseline: The exact same recent-30 strictly earlier creator baseline used by the selected prediction at every point.
rollingBlockStability.partition: For each account, all causally scorable rows from minimum history through the 80% boundary are split into four non-overlapping chronological chunks with numpy.array_split.
rollingBlockStability.status: retrospective stability audit, not a blind claim
rollingBlockStability.warning: The locked formula was selected on the 50%-80% window, which overlaps later prefinal blocks. These blocks test temporal stability only and are separate from the final-tail claim.

equalTimestampAudit.policy: All features may use rows with publishedAt strictly less than the target. Creator centering, rolling corrections, expert gates, mixture weights, and conformal residual stores update only after the entire equal-time batch is predicted.

labelAudit.target: Cumulative YouTube Studio stayed-to-watch value at the recorded scrape snapshot.
labelAudit.warning: The current labels were observed at different video ages. This benchmark predicts the recorded snapshot target; it does not establish a fixed post-upload horizon.

formula.model: Selection-locked prequential 50/50 residual-analog and semantic-stack mixture

lockedFormula.formula: 0.5 * stage2 centered-together pooled residual analog + 0.5 * stage3 visual+together semantic stack
lockedFormula.label: Causal keep-rate mixture

formula.outputTransform: clip(0.5 * centered-together residual analog + 0.5 * visual+together semantic stack, 0, 100)
formula.profileRequirement: The caller must supply an explicit creator profile with at least eight strictly earlier measured keep outcomes. Anonymous scoring must return unavailable.
formula.determinism: The same pinned visual and together matrices, creator history, equal-time batches, candidate registry, locked formula, and source code produce the same percentage.
